name: Aruba 570 Series Outdoor Access Points
description: Weatherproof and temperature hardened, HPE Aruba Networking 570 Series Outdoor Access Points deliver the highest Wi-Fi 6 performance in outdoor and environmentally challenging locations. The high performance and high power 570 series access points deliver maximum capacity and range. It delivers 4x4:4SS MU-MIMO capability, HPE Aruba Networking's advanced ClientMatch and integrated Bluetooth to enable HPE Aruba Networking location services.
tagline: High performance Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) for outdoor environments
